name: Lokalise push tracer (WRITES to Lokalise + Slack)
description: Traces a Lokalise push post to its Jira ticket, reviews the new strings, tags the keys and replies in the Slack thread. Called by the ticket-emoji watcher.

parameters.jsCode:
const c = $('Config').first().json;
return ['develop', 'main'].map(b => ({ json: { repo: c.repo, branch: b, since: c.since, until: c.until } }));
return [{ json: { channel: 'C0BFQ8FH9BM', ts: '1792492614.513009', project_name: 'RealChecker', tickets_in_post: ['REALCHECK-611'] } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4.1', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.system }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt } ] }) }}
